title: Meet patients at the Turtle Hospital
description: At the Turtle Hospital in Marathon, a guided visit introduces sea turtles recovering from injury or illness and the people working to release them. Learn what treatment and rehabilitation involve, then see the tanks where patients regain strength. The visit is more personal than a standard aquarium: each animal has a story, and the goal is a return to the sea.
teaser: See sea turtles being cared for in the Florida Keys.
goodToKnow: Before you go, confirm tour reservations and walking/standing requirements.
whyItMightDelightYou: Meeting a patient makes marine conservation feel specific, practical, and hopeful.
